02The commercial problem

Hotels can have excellent spas, treatments, fitness, partners and facilities and still struggle to turn that wellness investment into clear commercial demand.

The commercial principle

More wellness is not automatically better wellness.

The commercial opportunity is turning what the property offers into an offer the right guests understand, value and choose.

05How it works

Strategic Wellness Advisory. A defined partnership with an agreed scope, timeline and fee.

Strategic

ALT‑15° works alongside senior leadership, providing ongoing strategic input as decisions arise.

Focused

The engagement is intentionally senior and focused. The hotel retains execution and operational ownership.

The value

Hotels invest heavily in spas, fitness, treatments and recovery, then struggle to turn that investment into revenue. Facilities look like every competitor’s, sit underused at quieter hours, and are never packaged into offers guests understand or the commercial team can sell. ALT‑15° identifies where that investment is losing value, then defines what to lead with, who it is for and how it is packaged, priced and sold, so wellness can lift spend per guest, ancillary revenue and repeat stays.

ALT‑15° does not run the spa, manage therapists, organise rotas, procure products, manage day-to-day operations or replace the hotel’s operational team.
